headline: Strong order book addition as well as sales execution guidance intact

highlights: H1FY27 revenue grew 26% vs. its guidance of 15%+ FY27, indicating a strong possibility of BEL meeting its target.
OB additions of INR 550bn largely depend upon QRSAM orders (INR 300bn) – likely to arrive by Dec’26.
We expect the company to marginally surpass its guidance given a sizeable TAM.
Given consecutive quarters of outperformance, we upgrade BEL to BUY; TP of INR 446 (based on 40x FY28E EPS).
valuation: H1FY27 revenue grew 26% vs. its guidance of 15%+ FY27, indicating a strong possibility of BEL meeting its target.

BEL is also investing significantly in its R&D capabilities and is expected to increase the expenditure here to INR 22bn in FY27 to target non-defence revenues over the next 4– 5 years through data centres, cyber security, rail and space; all while increasing its potential TAM size.
AMCA • BEL has submitted a bid in consortium with L&T on 50:50 basis. • 2-3 months of technical evaluation is expected before the price bid is opened.
watch: Management is maintaining its guidance of +15% growth for FY27; thus, with stronger execution, the key monitorable remains timely order bookings to steer away from the top-line outpacing its OB and shortening the ramp for revenue visibility.
The recipient should independently evaluate the investment risks.
